facts.text: Gnomon offers a Bachelor of Fine Arts in Digital Production requiring 180 credit units across 12 ten-week terms, with concentrations in Game Art or Visual Effects Animation.

sources.title: BFA Degree in Digital Production | Gnomon - Gnomon
sources.quote: Gnomon's Bachelor of Fine Arts in Digital Production (BFA) is a full-time program designed to produce production-ready artists who are versed in general academic knowledge, foundational arts, and production skills.
